title: Lavandula angustifolia tincture for medicinal use
intro: Lavandula angustifolia tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made by soaking the dried flowers of lavender in alcohol, allowing the active compounds to be extracted. This tincture is widely used in herbalism for its calming and soothing properties. It is commonly employed to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and stress-related conditions. Additionally, it may help with skin irritations and minor wounds due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. In traditional medicine, it is also used to support digestive health and relieve headaches.
